paragraphs: I'm a Senior Software Engineer with {yearsExp}+ years of experience building full-stack web applications and microservices with .NET and React for regulatory-compliance and ERP platforms. At Kaz Software, I built core RegAnalytics modules, shipped LLM-powered streaming content generation, cut document-editor autosave latency by ~80% with Redis caching, and built serverless AWS pipelines for document processing.
I lead architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and own delivery from planning to production, using AI-assisted tools like Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and MCP to ship faster.

experience.description: Leading development of the RegAnalytics and RegPlus regulatory-compliance platforms, with a focus on LLM-powered features, Redis caching and serverless AWS pipelines.
responsibilities: Lead development of RegAnalytics and RegPlus, regulatory-compliance platforms built on .NET and React.
Built LLM-powered content generation that streams responses to the editor in real time, using the surrounding document as context, cutting first-draft writing time by ~40%.
Designed a Redis (ElastiCache) caching layer for document-editor autosave, reducing latency from ~1.2 s to under 250 ms.
Built serverless AWS pipelines (Lambda, S3, SQS, EventBridge) for document processing and background jobs.
Lead technical design reviews, mentor 3 engineers through code review and pairing, and own features from planning to production.

experience.description: Built core modules of RegAnalytics, a regulatory-compliance SaaS platform, working across the full stack with .NET Core and React.
responsibilities: Built the RegBrief and Workspace modules of RegAnalytics from an early stage, letting compliance teams create, organize and share regulatory briefings and documents in one place.
Worked with product managers and UX/UI designers to define requirements and turn designs into production features across the full stack.

experience.description: Built ERP modules for Procurement, Inventory and Approval Management on a shared .NET Core platform.
responsibilities: Built and maintained ERP modules for Procurement, Inventory and Approval Management.
Developed RESTful APIs in .NET Core (C#) to integrate ERP modules with other business systems.
Fixed production bugs and tuned slow SQL queries, improving platform stability and report performance.
Delivered client-specific ERP customizations with cross-functional teams.
